amendments.name: E5 query/query prefix ablation
amendments.reason: Official E5 FAQ recommends query prefixes on both sides for paraphrase retrieval; our benchmark matches questions. Add a separate labeled development condition, preserve original query/passage condition.
amendments.selection: Eligible for the same frozen 50/50 English/Korean development selection score. No heldout scores inspected.

amendments.name: Additional holdout sources
amendments.reason: Only 9 ServerFault cases matched the original rule. Before new-model accuracy runs, froze supplemental AskUbuntu/SuperUser acquisition; now 91 original cases and 20 translated controls, all later than 2025-07-01.

amendments.name: Staged reranker depth and pair reuse
amendments.reason: Actual large-model timing makes exhaustive repeated top50 scoring wasteful. Before either reranker accuracy score, compare both on identical top20 candidates, then expand the leading combination to top50 and test a same-budget dense/BM25 union. Cache only identical model/prompt/query/document scores; do not use cache timings as latency measurements.
amendments.screening: Both rerankers on baseline dense top20 and best encoder top20. Choose using the unchanged development criterion. Then top50 dense versus up-to50 union candidates for selected combination.
amendments.holdout: Still untouched; lock the final pipeline before final scoring.

amendments.name: One finalist full-index budget
amendments.reason: GPU smoke measurements project over90 minutes for both larger encoders. Index time is an offline cost, not query latency; the user authorized overnight experimentation. Permit up to3 hours for exactly one selected full-corpus encoding while retaining all cost observations. This is a runtime-budget amendment, not a claim of hardware infeasibility or a change to relevance scoring.

amendments.name: Cluster-aware final uncertainty
amendments.reason: Before final model scores, source labels show 91 original holdout questions form 80 components when shared relevant records are connected. Translations also share source questions. Naive independent-query intervals can overstate precision.
amendments.method: Build components using shared source_id or any shared gold document; paired bootstrap 2000 seed20261118 samples components and recomputes query-weighted delta. Report English and Korean strata separately and flag fewer than20 components. This does not establish complete statistical independence or population representativeness.
